represented_appearance: Visible concrete bridge and August 2024 deck furnishings; primary architect photos inform structural form. Dimensions estimated and checked against mapped scale.

sources.attribution: Nicoll Russell Studios; linked photographs retained privately, not published
sources.observations: Primary project page confirms 150 m bridge. Photos southport02/03/04/05/06/07 show two elliptical legs, separate pointed caps, dark steel anchorage crosshead, six paired main stays, three paired backstays, edge anchors and underside ribs.

Actual GPU-rendered textured 3D orbited through headings 0,92.5,185,277.5. Main span toward hotel, pylon near west bank, clustered backstays on two widened anchor terraces. Eastern lower promenade passes below deck.
Plan scale, retaining edges, pylon position, main deck, west anchor flares and lake/promenade handovers. Elevated object parallax allowed.

Blue picket rails, curved outboard brackets and two tension wires, white stay sheaths/black collars, tan pedestrian surface, grey cycle strip, white separator, lantern bollards on separator, linear kerb drainage.
Opposite deck approach, outward pylon legs, lamps and railings on both sides, existing shallow road crest.

Visible panorama despite no-imagery warning confirms three thick backstays per side anchored to three stepped concrete wedges on widened western terraces; surface colour older and not used as current paint evidence.
Archive catalogue identifies southeast view of pylon; catalogue metadata checked, full archive photograph not relied on.
Existing Marine corridor retained mapped axis; new dimensional controls checked against actual aerial/3D.
